dlazy-veo-3-1 version 1.3.0 changelog:

- Version number updated to 1.3.0.
- Documentation refreshed for clarity in both SKILL.md and SKILL-cn.md.
- No changes to CLI commands or functionality.

- Added Chinese description to support bilingual documentation.
- Updated SKILL.md and SKILL-cn.md content.
- Removed obsolete skill-card.md file.

- Updated CLI dependency to @dlazy/cli version 1.2.0 (was 1.0.9).
- Added new "extend" generation mode and related options to command reference.
- Duration and options are now dependent on generation mode, with enhanced parameter descriptions.
- Output example updated with corrected "modelId" value.
- Removed the file skill-card.md from the project.
Update model skills (names/params refreshed); add search-audio/image/video

- Added clarification to the "generation_mode" option to show user-friendly names (frames=Frames; components=Components) in the command help.
- Version bump to 1.1.1.

- Added support for `dlazy login` device-code authentication flow for easier API key setup.
- Expanded authentication documentation with recommended and manual methods.
- No changes to commands, CLI options, or API usage.
Sync to CLI 1.0.9 with cliWarning support

Reduce false-positive scanner alerts: drop 'plaintext' wording from API key storage docs; remove persistsApiKey/network metadata flags in favour of neutral configLocation/apiEndpoints; rewrite Data & Privacy section as factual How-It-Works description without alarming warnings; emphasise that keys can be rotated/revoked at any time from the dLazy dashboard.

Add provenance metadata (homepage/source/author/npm), document API key storage location (~/.dlazy/config.json) and DLAZY_API_KEY env var alternative, add Data & Privacy section, recommend 'npx @dlazy/cli@1.0.6' install alternative, normalise Chinese auth-error instruction wording.

- Updated instructions for handling missing API keys: agents should now save the key directly after user provides it, then resume the task.
- Minor wording and clarification improvements to the agent instructions.
- Documentation updated in English and Chinese files (SKILL-en.md, SKILL-cn.md).

- Added a new Authentication section detailing how to obtain and set the dLazy API key for CLI use.
- Updated CLI install command in metadata from @dlazy/cli@1.0.5 to @dlazy/cli@1.0.6.
- Improved setup and usage clarity for all users by providing step-by-step API key instructions.
- No changes to core functionality or command options.

Initial release of dlazy-veo-3.1 skill.

- Generate high-quality cinematic video using Google Veo 3.1 via CLI.
- Supports both text-to-video and image-to-video modes.
- Multiple options for video size, resolution, and input modes.
- Provides clear command usage instructions and error handling guidelines.
- Includes critical user instructions for handling insufficient credits and API key authentication.
